reference.code: import java.util.*; public final class Solution { public static List<String> parseQuotedList(String s){var out=new ArrayList<String>();if(s.isEmpty())return out;int i=0;while(true){if(i>=s.length()||s.charAt(i)!='"')return null;i++;var b=new StringBuilder();boolean closed=false;while(i<s.length()){if(s.charAt(i)=='"'){if(i+1<s.length()&&s.charAt(i+1)=='"'){b.append('"');i+=2;}else{i++;closed=true;break;}}else b.append(s.charAt(i++));}if(!closed)return null;out.add(b.toString());if(i==s.length())return out;if(s.charAt(i++)!=','||i==s.length())return null;}} }
